<thought>To determine the number of carbonyl groups, I will obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample using the carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Then I will retrieve the typical chemical shift range for carbonyl carbons with retrieve_carbon_shifts. By counting how many peaks fall within that carbonyl region, I can infer the number of carbonyl groups.</thought>
<action>carbon_nmr_spectra</action>
